source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, before anyone sets up a unit, you may divide this unit into 2 units of 5 models each.

ability.when: Declare Battle Formations step: at its start, before units are set up

lastPrinted.note: Build 972, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Tactical Squad datasheet; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
